original_value: A fictional 27-inch QHD monitor designed for color-accurate studio work, smooth desktop gaming, and everyday productivity. It features a 165Hz refresh rate, 1ms response tuning, 95% DCI-P3 coverage, and an adjustable aluminum stand with USB-C input and 65W power delivery. The panel uses anti-glare coating, supports adaptive sync, and includes built-in dual speakers for compact setups.
